Kadhai se nikal kar aag mein girna.
Bina gyan ki chaturai zehrile teer jaisi hai.
Buddhi buddhi ki muskaan hai.
Dil wo raaz rakhta hai jo hont bata dete hain.
Sankhyaayein brahmand par raj kare.
Ek chalak dhokha pavitra mukhote ke peeche chhupta hai.
Baanta gaya dukh aadha bojh halka kar deta hai.
Gyaan chhupi hui sone se behtar hai.
Hum agyanta ke shant samudra par chalte hain.
Nadi se mat lado; tairna seekho.
Ek chalak bhesh moorkh ko nahi chhupa sakta.
Langar sirf gahre paani mein tike.
Teekha dimaag maya ke aar-paar nikal jata hai.
Buddhi tez vichar ki khubsurti hai.
Dil ek aisa kila hai jise todna mushkil hai.
Jeevan ko saans se nahi, palon se maapo.
Naram shabd kathor loha tod de.
Hansi zulm ki zanjeerein tod deti hai.
Rooh mein aise toofani chhupe hain jo aankh nahi dekh sakti.
Man uthal-puthal samudra jaisa hai.
Bhavnayein andar ke samrajya par raaj karti hain.
Teekhi buddhi shaan pathar se bhi tez tez hoti hai.
Buddhi kadve imtihaanon ka meetha phal hai.
Ek teekha vyang kadwe dushman ko nishastra karta hai.
Ek chatur jeebh shahi farmaan se behtar hai.
Teekha dimaag sach ka kila hai.
Shaant man shaant sansaar hai.
Ahankari dil vastavikta se takra kar toot ta hai.
Jo apne krodh par kaabu rakhe, wahi beda chalata hai.
Teekhi jubaan aag ke pul banati hai.
Tark darshanik ka kavach hai.
Aane wala kal aaj ka vidyarthi hai.
Sammelan virodhiyon se janm leta hai.
Satya bina baisakhi ke chale.
Nirasha ek daldal hai jo vicharon ko nigal leti hai.
Ek chalak muskaan bach nikalne wale ki pehchaan hai.
Gyan wo langar hai jo shak me bhi mazboot rehta hai.
Buddhi jeevant dimaag ki saans hai.
Sabse gehre paani shant chalte hain, jaise chalak sadyantra.
Ek chatur baat vyang ka gola hai.
Mahatwakanksha bheton ke baade mein bhediya hai.
Har deewar ek intezaar karti darwaaza hai.
Rooh us cheez ke liye tadapti hai jise chhoo na sake.
Hum prithvi naapte hain, par dimaag nahi naap paate.
Hansi samajhdari ka sangeet hai.
Ek mazak nafrat ki sabse badi khaai ko jod sakta hai.
Hasti hui aatma kabhi boodhi nahi hoti.
Ek chatur tippani jeebh par dhalas sona hai.
Saral jeevan dhanwaan jeevan hai.
